name: Nachos with Salsa
steps: Preheat the oven to 190°C. Dice tomatoes and onion finely and chop coriander.
Mix tomato, onion, coriander, lime juice and salt for the salsa. Drain excess watery tomato juice so it does not soak the chips.
Rinse and drain cooked black beans, then warm with cumin and a splash of water for 3–4 minutes.
Spread chips on a baking tray, scatter beans and grated cheese made with vegetarian rennet over them.
Bake for 5–7 minutes, just until the cheese melts. Watch carefully because thin chips scorch quickly.
Serve immediately with salsa on the side or spooned on at the last moment.
tips: Prepare components ahead, but combine wet dressings and crisp ingredients just before serving.
notes: Quantities are for four adult portions. Cooking times are estimates; use the doneness checks in each step. Ingredient costs use sample rates and exclude unpriced items.
